datasets.task: Protein localization representation; proposed multi-label localization/retrieval
datasets.official_split: 2021-opencell-figures is figure-analysis code, not a supervised train/validation/test release. Cytoself provides a reproducible FOV-aware split convention (0.82/0.098/0.082, seed1, per-cell-line grouping); use only when corresponding FOV identities are available.
datasets.grouping: Cell-line/protein and FOV; all crops from an FOV remain together. For protein-held-out localization generalization, keep all cells of a tagged protein together and classify localization, not protein identity; this is a separate proposed task.
datasets.metric: Original figure analyses include localization Leiden-clustering ARI and protein localization similarities, not an official DINOv3 classifier headline. Proposed multi-label localization uses macro-AP with macro-AUROC/F1 secondary; retrieval needs explicitly defined positives/exclusions.
datasets.blocker: Local repository contains metadata/annotations and figure-analysis scripts but no microscopy image payload or canonical benchmark split. Cytoself precomputed embeddings must never substitute for DINOv3 features. Acquire pixel data plus exact annotation/FOV mapping before loader/protocol freeze.

local_evidence.existing_evaluator: Reuse bio_frozen_eval multi-label logistic/linear, retrieval, and feature extraction after a loader is justified
